text:
maria (support): FYI - ZephyrPay reporting spikes of 504s and very high p95 on hosted API since ~10:15 UTC. Example trace id: trace_0a9f. Customer says 1/5 requests time out, mostly long-gen requests (max_tokens=1024). Escalating.
eng_infra_oncall: On it. Which region? Any tenant-specific routing? Can you drop a repro curl and one sample log line?
maria (support): Region eu-west-1. Repro curl they sent:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer SK_REDACTED" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","prompt":"x","max_tokens":1024}'
```
Sample gateway log (trimmed):
```
2026-03-17T10:21:03Z hosted-gateway request_id=trace_0a9f status=504 queue_depth=1276 dequeue_latency_ms=3520 continuous_batch_backlog=2203 tenant=zephyrpay
```
eng_infra_oncall: queue_depth ~1276 is very high. Dashboard shows continuous_batcher_queue ~2.2k and dequeue throughput dropped ~40% starting 10:10. Paging SREs. @brian can you add emergency capacity and consider tenant isolation? :rotating_light:
brian (SRE): Ack. Kicking emergency scale in eu-west-1 now. Increasing hosted pool by 3 GPU nodes and bumping per-tenant max_queue_depth for zephyrpay from 512 -> 2048 temporarily. Running:
```
redwood-admin capacity add --pool hosted-eu-1 --gpus 3 --reason "zephyrpay incident 2026-03-17"
redwood-admin route update --tenant zephyrpay --max_queue_depth 2048
```
srebot: Autoscaler: launched 3 nodes in hosted-eu-1 (node-axx, node-ayb, node-azc). Current pool utilization 78%.
alice (runtime): Observed heavy long-seq KV-cache churn for zephyrpay; cold KV-cache misses are making dequeue slower. Batching window currently 200ms which aggregates long sequences into huge batches and increases tail. Suggest two immediate mitigations: 1) set batching.max_latency_ms=50 for tenant route to favor latency over throughput, 2) enable fallback to small/quantized variant for requests >512 tokens.
eng_infra_oncall: Good call. Applying short batching window override for zephyrpay route now.
```
redwood-admin route update --tenant zephyrpay --batching.max_latency_ms 50
redwood-admin route update --tenant zephyrpay --fallback_model redwood-small-quant-v1 --fallback_threshold_tokens 512
```
carol (product): We're drafting a customer note. Asking them to reduce max_tokens temporarily and will offer monitoring + credits. Sending update at 10:34 UTC.
deploy-bot: Canary fallback rollout started for tenant zephyrpay -> redwood-small-quant-v1 at 10:37 UTC (canary 5% traffic).
eng_infra_oncall: After scale + batching override + canary, metrics trending down. queue_depth peaked at 1280 then fell to ~180 by 10:50. p95 went from ~8.2s -> 420ms. Still monitoring for recurrence.
srebot: Alert cleared for gateway-504-spike at 10:52 UTC.
support_lead: Great work. Customer comms: confirmed ZephyrPay acknowledged receiving note and will throttle long-job clients. Requested 1 week credit. Please capture timeline and repro steps for postmortem.
brian (SRE): Postmortem action items I'm adding:
- replay test: 500 concurrent clients sending 1024-token gen to hosted-eu-1 (repro locally)
- revisit default per-tenant max_queue_depth and add adaptive eviction for continuous_batcher
- investigate KV-cache warmup strategy to avoid cold miss avalanche
- add tenant isolation knob (soft per-tenant CPU/GPU share)
- add alert to notify at continuous_batcher_queue > 750 for >2m
alice (runtime): Repro notes: local stress harness reproduces queue build if batching.max_latency_ms >= 150 and seq_len >= 800 with mixed KV variants. With max_latency_ms=50 we do not see the same tail at same qps; throughput drops ~15% but tail latency improves dramatically.
maria (support): Customer updated us: errors stopped after 10:45 and traffic looks healthy. They accepted temporary guidance and will work on request shaping. They asked when billing credit decision will be ready.
support_lead: We'll review credits after postmortem. For now mark incident resolved and set follow-up meeting. Closing thread but keep logs attached to PM.
eng_infra_oncall: Incident resolved 11:05 UTC. Will attach traces and run replay tomorrow to validate recurrence and fix rollouts.
carol (product): Noting customer retention risk; follow-up scheduled with account exec.

---
Post-incident quick logs snapshot (for record):
```
2026-03-17T10:09:47Z continuous-batcher queue_len=2203 dequeue_rate=420/s schedule_window_ms=200
2026-03-17T10:21:03Z hosted-gateway request_id=trace_0a9f status=504 queue_depth=1276 dequeue_latency_ms=3520 tenant=zephyrpay
2026-03-17T10:37:15Z deploy-bot canary route=zephyrpay -> redwood-small-quant-v1 canary=5%
2026-03-17T10:50:12Z continuous-batcher queue_len=178 dequeue_rate=880/s schedule_window_ms=50
```
Follow-ups: replay stress test, revise batch window defaults, tenant isolation, and KV-cache cold-warm strategy.
